title: smb sink
description: Writes the message body to a file in a directory of an SMB server.

path.title: Address
path.description: From the URI: smb://[user@]host[:port]/share[/directory]. The first part of the path is the share; the directory is below it. A backslash is a slash

userName.title: User name
userName.description: User to log in as, or DOMAIN\user; the URI can give it too

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Windows domain of the user, if any

disconnect.title: Disconnect
disconnect.description: Close the connection after each use; false keeps it open between uses, until it is idle for 30 seconds

socketTimeout.title: Timeout
socketTimeout.description: Milliseconds to connect and log in

fileName.title: File name
fileName.description: Name of the file; the header file.name or CamelFileName, else the trace id, if empty

binary.title: Binary
binary.description: Write the body as it is instead of in charset

charset.title: Charset
charset.description: Charset of the file: UTF-8, ISO-8859-1 or US-ASCII

fileExist.title: If the file exists
fileExist.description: Override, Append, Fail (fail the message) or Ignore (write nothing)
